nom: Arencia Vitamin C Booster Shot Serum with Glutathione

avis.texte: I am honestly obsessed with this serum! The Arencia Vitamin C Booster Shot Serum feels so lightweight and refreshing on the skin—it absorbs instantly and doesn’t leave any sticky or greasy residue. From the first few uses, my skin already looked more radiant and awake. What really stood out is how bright and even my complexion started to look after consistent use. It gives that healthy glow without irritation, which is rare for a vitamin C product. I also love that it layers effortlessly with the rest of my skincare and works great under makeup. This is one of those products that makes your skin look better over time while still giving quick visible results. If you’re looking for a glow-boosting serum that actually delivers, this one is a must-try!

avis.titre: VITAMINA C BOOSTER SHOTVITAMINA C BOOSTER SHOT
avis.texte: This serum met my expectations. It feels very lightweight without leaving any sticky residue, and it absorbs instantly. I've noticed a change in my skin; it looks a bit clearer and has a nice glow. I liked it a lot, and it has become one of my favorite skincare products

avis.titre: Brightening serum that actually delivers glow.Brightening serum that actually delivers glow.
avis.texte: I’ve been using the Arencia Vitamin C Booster Shot for a few weeks now and it’s become a staple in my routine. The formula feels lightweight and absorbs quickly without any sticky residue, which I appreciate since I layer it under other products. The combo of Vitamin C, glutathione, and niacinamide is doing real work on my dark spots — I’ve noticed my overall tone looking more even and my skin has that “glass skin” glow people talk about. The vitamin E keeps it from feeling drying, which is a common issue with vitamin C serums. A little goes a long way, and the pump dispenser makes it easy to control how much I use. I do make sure to wear SPF the next morning since vitamin C can make skin more sun-sensitive — just a heads up for anyone trying it. Great option if you’re looking to add a Korean skincare brightening serum to your routine. Will repurchase!

avis.titre: Great serum, definitely recommend.Great serum, definitely recommend.
avis.texte: I love this serum so far. I have been using this serum for 2 weeks now and I am noticing that my skin is becoming lighter. I want to mention that I have an oily and acne prone skin, a lot of facial care products give me breakouts, but this one has been great so far, and I plan to get another one after the current serum runs out. My favorite part is that this serum has a great rating in Yuka app, so it’s safe for your skin!
Tried it once so not much to tell you about But definitely not the best among the vit c products out there Bought it because of the videos on tiktok but i do not think i will repeat the purchase

I seen a view from from Instagram that pointed in the direction to by Arencia and I've been buying an using for a month or so and I see difference in my knuckles and elbows. I had a small scar on my forearm and it's almost gone. I'm excited to try their Vitamin C Facial Spray. Not greasy at all. I love also that it's fragrance free. I don't like the high price tag - I feel as though it could be less in cost. It is effective - I do carry with me to work, so after I wash my hands, I use it on each specific area.

I love this serum. It makes my skin look really nice and healthy. I was having an acne breakout, and now my skin looks so much better. I use it every morning and night, and I feel like it really helps brighten my dark spots. Very good product and definitely worth trying.
Llego rápido y bien empaquetado. Tiene buena textura y se absorbe bien. Cuando lo haya utilizado unas semanas podre valorarlo mejor. Por el momento muy bien.

avis.titre: ベタつかず使いやすい！肌の明るさを実感中
avis.texte: TikTokで話題になっているのを見て、肌のくすみやニキビ跡のケアをしたくて購入しました。 使い始めてまだ1週間ほどですが、気になっていたニキビ跡が少しずつ薄くなってきたように感じています。肌全体も以前より明るく見える気がして、これからの変化が楽しみです。 テクスチャーはみずみずしく、ベタつきや油っぽさがないので、とても使いやすいです。暑い季節でも快適に使えると思います。 今のところ肌荒れなどのトラブルもなく、継続して使ってみたいと思える美容液です。
Great product and have best result and special thanks from Gift
Buen producto lo uso para mi rutina de skincare , recomendado ayuda aclarar imperfecciones

avis.titre: Inconsistent color between purchases - be cautious
avis.texte: I've purchased this Arencia Vitamin C Booster Shot Serum twice now, and I noticed a significant inconsistency between the two batches. My first bottle was a bright yellow color, which I assume is typical for a Vitamin C serum. However, my second purchase came in a much lighter, almost washed-out shade. I'm not sure if this points to a difference in formulation, concentration, or just batch variation, but the color difference was noticeable enough that I didn't feel comfortable using the second bottle. Vitamin C serums can oxidize or degrade over time or with improper storage, so a lighter color made me question whether the product was still as potent or if something was off with that particular batch. I wish there was more clarity from the brand on why this happens - is it normal batch-to-batch variation, or a sign of a quality control issue? Without that reassurance, I didn't want to risk applying it to my skin. If you're a repeat buyer, I'd recommend paying close attention to the color and texture when you receive a new bottle, and reaching out to the seller if you notice a difference like this.

This serum is amazing. The combination pf vitamin C, niacinamide, and glutathione really shows. It leaves the skin with a healthey glow instantly and helps even out the skin tone. It absorbs quickly wilhout feeling greasy

avis.titre: Mi opinión: una crema que deja la piel más luminosa e hidratada
avis.texte: La crema Vitamin C Booster Shot me ha parecido una muy buena opción para el cuidado diario de la piel. Tiene una textura ligera, se absorbe rápidamente y no deja sensación grasosa. Después de usarla de forma constante, la piel luce más hidratada, suave y con un aspecto más luminosa el precio me parece muy absesible

I’ve been using this Vitamin C serum for a few days, and my skin looks brighter and feels smoother. It absorbs quickly, isn’t greasy, and layers well under moisturizer and makeup. Overall, it’s a great addition to my skincare routine, and I’d definitely recommend it.

I just ordered my second bottle & have to say it’s good quality. This is something that’s affordable & won’t break your bank! The bottle lasts for about a month & half, I use it for my morning & night routine! I use it the arencia vit c booster serum along with a mixsoon vit c & occasionally a retinol. I’ve noticed by using these products together I’ve gotten good results & see a difference in my skin tone. Im a retired licensed esthetician & definitely recommend this product!

I’ve been really enjoying this one. It’s super lightweight, sinks in fast, and doesn’t leave that sticky feeling some vitamin C products have. My skin feels fresh and looks a bit brighter after using it consistently. I like that it’s gentle enough for both my face and under-eye area, which makes my routine simpler. It gives a nice, subtle glow rather than anything too intense. Only thing to keep in mind—if your skin is very sensitive, you might feel a slight tingle at first. And like most vitamin C products, results on dark spots take time. Overall: an easy, no-fuss product that helps your skin look more awake and radiant.

I had a red spot, I don't know if from the sun or from creams, since I have sensitive skin, I've been using this for a month now and you can already see the difference. Recommend It's already part of my routine

I’ve been using Arencia Vitamin C booster couple of days, I can confidently say it’s one of the most impressive skincare boosters I’ve tried. The texture is lightweight yet nourishing, absorbing quickly without leaving any sticky residue. After consistent use, I’ve noticed visible improvements in firmness and elasticity, especially around my under-eye area. My skin looks smoother, more refined, and has a healthy glow that wasn’t there before. Fine lines appear softened, and my overall complexion feels more resilient. I knew that vitamin C brightens skin tone, but I recently learned that added glutathione acts as a booster. I heard that Beyoncé often uses glutathione. Because two substances are applied to the skin at the same time, it was really great because my skin tone brightened and I felt like I was losing blemishes. The scent was like green grass and citrus, but it was almost fragrance-free and not very irritating. I would highly recommend this to anyone who is concerned about their skin texture becoming brighter and blemishes appearing on their skin.

I’ve been using this product for over three weeks, morning and night. I’ve already noticed that my acne pigmentation is fading faster, which is one of my biggest skin concerns. I’m really happy with the results so far. I will definitely repurchase once I run out. This is my first time trying Arencia, and I’m very impressed. Now I’m curious to try their other products too!

I’ve been using this Vitamin C Booster Shot for a few days and really like the texture. It’s gentle around the eyes and adds a subtle brightness without irritation. Good moisturizer with a clean feel.

Worth it!!!! I’ve been using this every morning as the first step before sunscreen and the difference is noticeable. My makeup applies so much more evenly now, and my skin looks smoother overall. I had previously tried a similar product from another brand, but it didn’t suit my skin and actually caused breakouts. This one, however, sinks in quickly with no irritation at all. I was surprised to see my post-acne marks start to look lighter within about a week. Overall, I’m really happy with the results!!

avis.texte: Lightweight, non-irritating vitamin C that gives an instant glow and layers perfectly under sunscreen and makeup. My skin looks more even and radiant after just a week of use. Gentle enough for sensitive skin and even works well around the eyes. Would definitely repurchase.

Excellent product! No annoying smell, absorbs quickly, super light and is already making a difference!!! Also beautiful packaging. I am super excited about this product and will definitely be repurchasing!

The texture is lightweight and absorbs quickly without leaving any sticky or greasy feeling, which makes it easy to layer with other products. I’ve noticed my skin looking brighter and more even, especially with some of my darker spots starting to fade gradually. It also gives a subtle glow that makes my skin look healthier overall. The combination of vitamin C, niacinamide, and glutathione works well together to improve tone and smooth out the skin. Another thing I like is that it doesn’t irritate my skin, even with consistent use. It feels gentle but still effective. My skin also feels a bit smoother, and fine lines look slightly softened. The only downside is the small bottle—it runs out pretty quickly if you use it daily. But overall, it’s a great serum if you’re looking for something to brighten your skin and improve dark spots without being too harsh. This product is moisturizing enough and great value for the money!

avis.titre: Great brightening ingredients. Multiple forms of Vitamin C could irritate very sensitive skin.
avis.texte: I am a big fan of Korean skincare, and Arencia is one of my favorite Korean brands. So I was excited to try this vitamin C booster shot serum. This formula contains multiple forms of vitamin C derivatives and niacinamide for brightening. It also contains a solid mix of ingredients for hydration and skin soothing. The tube is quite small, but only a little is needed to cover the face. While I really like this brand, and think this contains an impressive collection of ingredients, I have rosacea and very easily irritated skin and this product caused my rosacea to flare up. I think this reaction would be a risk for a very small portion of users. Though I personally do not feel safe using this with my compromised skin, this remains a great brand in my mind and I feel this is fairly priced at $13.

This ultra small tube of vitamin c “booster” is a nice addition to my travel bag for business trips. The product is only .33 ounces and I would strictly recommend this size for traveling only; as daily use would have it completely used up in less than 2 weeks. I like using this product on my face, but it also works well to “pep up” my eyes again. Overapplying does cause my skin to flare up but when applied moderately I don’t have any issues. The formula is a bit gel like and kind of greasy; it will dry with a sort of dewy finish. This product is a nice final step to add a bit of lasting moisture. Check your price per ounce to make sure you’re getting the best value though; because I would never reorder this size for $14, YIKES

This is a well-executed trendy sort of product with a formula that actually focuses more on usability and experience than raw actives. It comes in a small needle-tip tube, making it easy to control where and how much you apply. The texture is a viscous gel-cream with a slight yellow-green tint. It spreads easily, absorbs quickly, and settles into a smooth finish. It's more dry than dewy, which I actually prefer since it layers cleanly. It doesn’t seem to react to what’s underneath and does well with sunscreen or other products on top. There is a solid base here with humectants, light emollients, and niacinamide doing most of the real work. The vitamin C complex sounds strong on paper, but it’s mostly derivatives, and the effect is mild. It's the same idea with glutathione and vitamin E. They’re listed, but this isn’t a treatment-level product. This does a good job I think with providing consistent, low-irritation hydration with some gradual brightening support. I’ve had no irritation using it, including near the eye area, which is not something I’d say about quite a few vitamin C products. This is more about formulation quality and day-to-day usability than chasing high potency.

avis.titre: travel sized tube, silky hydration, no added fragrance, helps brighten over time
avis.texte: This is a very tiny little tube, but I really like this as a night serum. It goes on silky smooth and I find it to be far more hydrating than most typical formulas. Since I have dry and oily skin, I like a serious amount of moisturizing from each step in my skincare routine. No overpowering fragrance, but a light citrus. This is a gel so it has a thicker consistency. I did not see any immediate brightening, but I do believe that this has been helping over time. I apply a layer over my entire face, excluding the eyes. This 10 ml bottle won't last much longer, at 14 bucks, but it provided instant hydration, a subtle glow, and zero adverse effects. I would absolutely use this again, and be interested in trying more from arencia.

avis.titre: Nice serum to pair with other Arencia products, just small.
avis.texte: I have tried a few Arencia products and they are beautifully made and work well, so I was excited to try this Vitamin C booster shot serum when I came across it! It comes in a small tube. Be sure to ready the amount of product you’re getting as it can be disappointing if it’s smaller than you expect. But the price seems fair. The serum is a gel like texture, light green and clear. You only need about a pea sized amount. I have combo skin, oilier in the warmer months. I also suffer from cystic acne and new products can cause breakouts-so far no reaction! I have been using this serum for about 2 weeks and it’s nice. No major noticeable changes but I enjoy how my skin feels after. I pair it with the Arencia smoothie serum! My face is glowing and no breakouts. My issue is, I am about half way through the tube so I won’t really know how well the product works long term with just this one tube. Idk if I would repurchase based off the subtle changes I’ve seen so far. But great ingredients, might work better on someone else’s skin.

avis.titre: Helpful for dark spots and sunspots. Goes on smoothly, not sticky or shiny.
avis.texte: At 37, having spent a lot of time in the sun, I have quite a few sunspots and dark freckles. I started to use this after my PDRN and before my sunscreen and I do believe that it has helped with brightening the sunspots. It feels nice on my skin, it doesn't irritate it at all, and I haven't broken out while using it. My skin can be moderately sensitive. It doesn't feel greasy, but I do get a shiny forehead sometimes, and I'm not sure if it is because of this or just the weather getting warmer. All in all, I do think that it has been effective, but it is hard to measure how dark spots are. I do feel like they are certainly less noticeable though. The container is really cute, and the small size allows you to try and get used to it before deciding and committing. I don't notice a strong scent.

avis.titre: Instant Glow Booster That Brightens and Smooths Fast!
avis.texte: This Vitamin C booster serum is honestly so impressive because a little goes a very long way. As soon as you apply it, it gives your skin this silky buttery soft feel with a refreshing cooling effect that feels amazing especially under the eyes. I used it under my eyes first and instantly noticed a brighter more awake look with a beautiful healthy glow. The texture absorbs quickly without feeling sticky and leaves the skin feeling smooth hydrated and refreshed. I really love how lightweight it feels while still giving that immediate visible boost! What makes this even better is that it is packed with ingredients like Vitamin C glutathione niacinamide and Vitamin E which help brighten dullness improve skin texture and support a healthier looking tone. I have never tried this brand before but this product truly opened me up to wanting to explore more of their skincare because the results were noticeable right away. I could actually feel and see the difference after the first use and that says a lot. This little booster gel is awesome and absolutely worth the buy because it is effective priced right and gives instant results that make your skin look fresh radiant and glowing.

avis.titre: Arencia Vitamin C Booster Shot Serum 10ml/0.33 fl.oz
avis.texte: I ordered the Arencia Vitamin C Booster Shot Serum 10ml/0.33 fl.oz. The product arrived in a box marked made in Korea. There was a foil seal under the cap. The product dispenses via a tube. The serum is a medium viscocity, has no smell and rubs in with no color after it is rubbed in. The serum absorbs quickly and nicely. I feel moisturized after use and stay feeling moisturized for many hours after application. I dont feel greasy after use. I find this to be a pretty effective moisturizer. I havent yet noticed any brightening effects. If I do I will update this review. Because of the small size I m just using this as spot treatment, mostly over patches that are dry due to pimple treatment drying out the area. Because I am only using this a tiny bit at a time as a spot treatment, I find the serum at $14 for a 10ml tube to be a fair value. I am pleased with this product. It is moisturizing dry patches well without causing any kind of redness or irritation.

avis.titre: Brightening, gel-like texture & surprisingly gentle for under-eyes
avis.texte: I have been using the Arencia Vitamin C Booster shot for a few months now and I also recently got the travel sized tube which is great if you are looking to test this out without a huge commitment, or if want a mini size for travel. I wanted to incorporate more antioxidant care into my routine to tackle dullness and I have found a specific way to layer this that works really well. Here is a breakdown of my experience and how I get the most out of it. TEXTURE AND ABSORPTION The first thing you will notice is that the consistency isn't quite a standard liquid serum. It is more of a serum-gel hybrid. Because of this texture, it feels hydrating rather than sticky. It absorbs relatively quickly, but I have found that patience is key here. MY MORNING ROUTINE I strictly use this in the morning (I use the Arencia Retinal booster from the same line in the evening). I apply this immediately after my toner. Here is the trick that has worked for me: I let the product absorb for about two minutes before moving on to the next step. This ensures it settles into the skin properly. Once that time is up, I lock it in with my moisturizer. UNDER EYE APPLICATION This is the feature that actually surprised me the most. It is rare to find a Vitamin C product for your face that is gentle enough for the under eye area, but this one is. I use the same technique here as I do for my face. I apply a thin layer under my eyes as a targeted serum, wait the full two minutes and then seal it with my usual eye

avis.titre: Love the tube format; EXCELLENT product
avis.texte: I love Arencia and was able to select both this serum and the retinal serum which are meant to be used together in a set. It's such a great combo for a multitude of skin concerns and can be modified to fit your routine (I have sensitive, eczema and rosacea-prone skin and I stick with every day for the vitamin C and a few days a week for the retinal to avoid irritaton). Remember that the key to success with this type of product is 1) consistency and 2) start SLOW! Here are the full ingredients since they aren't in the listing and I couldn't find them online: Water, Glycerin, Methylpropanediol, 3-O-Ethyl Ascorbic Actd, Butytene Glycol, Caprytic/Capric Trigtyceride, 1,2-Hexanediol, Niscinamide, Cetyl Ethyihexanoate, Cetearyl Olivate, Polyglyceryt-3 Methylglucose Distearale, Diisostearyl Malate, Sodium Polyacrylate, Acryiates/C 10-30 Aikyt Acrylate Crosspotymer, Sorbitan Olivate, Arginine, Gardenia Floride Fruit Extract, Xanthan Gum, Ethythexyigiyoerin, Dextrin, Adenosine, Allantoin, Ascorbic Acid, Glutathione, Panthenol, Pyndoxne, Tocopherol, Ascorby! Gtucoside, Sodium Ascorbyl Phosphate This serum contains a blend of 3-O-Ethyl Ascorbic Acid (50,000 ppm) and Pure Vitamin C combined with another antioxidant, Vitamin E (tocopherol) to increase stability and efficacy. It also has several other beneficial ingredients: Niacinamide, Glutathione, Panthenol, and Allantoin. This formulation will help even and brighten skin tone, increase collagen production, reduce acne, and protect skin

I wouldn't really call this a serum, as it's more of a serum-cream hybrid. It's thinner than a cream, but thicker than a serum. It's really more on par with a gel moisturizer (like Clinique Moisture Surge in texture). I don't have a problem with this but I feel like it's important to note that it's thicker than any other Vitamin C serum I've ever used. I have a couple other products from this brand and like them so I was hoping I could say this was a win, and it's pretty close. With it being thicker, I wouldn't say it's great for the summer, but it also isn't so thick it would be difficult to wear during warmer months. Either way, it feels more like a winter product to me. I've been using Vitamin C products for awhile and this is pretty on par with others in terms of how my skin reacts to it. I like it, but I'm also fine using the serum I was using prior to this. They're both great. My serum is less expensive but I may want to use this more now that we're getting into winter.

avis.titre: Lots of Vit C in a comfortable lotion like serum
avis.texte: I know I should use Vitamin C products and based on the looks of my skin I NEED to be using Vitamin C products but so many I’ve tried are so heavy, shiny and sticky that all too often I’m skipping it. I just hate the feeling of those thicker, oily serums. Enter this “serum” from Arencia! It has a completely different texture and it’s one I can actually tolerate! They put 4 different forms of vitamin C in here that I recognize. 3-0 Ethyl Ascorbic Acid which is very stable, supposedly very well absorbed and good for brightening. It also has the powerhouse, Ascorbic Acid, which is the potent and pure form of Vitamin C we all like to see in products. And to round things off it also has SAP and Ascorbic Glucoside which are derivatives with beneficial properties. They’ve put other goodies in here too like Niacinamide that also helps fade discoloration and ingredients to moisturize and soothe skin. They’ve left out alcohol, fragrance and essential oils too! That was good to see since a lot of Vit C and brightening products seem to include essential oils which can be irritating. The serum feels like a thin silky lotion to me. It’s naturally a bright yellow since there are no artificial colorants in here. It spreads well so not much is needed. I use it as a spot treatment to concentrate on problemed areas and I follow to up with other serums and moisturizers. It feels a little tacky as it’s drying but certainly feels much nicer than most of the other Vitamin C products I have. I love

avis.titre: Arencia is the best - another win with the Vitamin C Booster Serum!
avis.texte: I absolutely love Arencia products, Korean skincare and Vitamin C for skincare, and was excited to order their Vitamin C Booster Serum. Because I am using a complete skincare routine except for treating my tired under eye area which has dark circles and bags, I added this as exclusively an undereye treatment. I love the ingredients - beyond Vitamin C it packs a powerful punch of Niacinamide, Glutathione< Panthenol, Allantoin and Vitamin E - a great combination for aging skin, firming, hydration and strengthening the skin barrier. In using for a few days, I have noticed a nice improvement in the dark circles and size of my under eye bags. I recognize that nothing is going to fully improve this area of concern for me so I am happy with a product that makes any noticeable difference. This cream is lightweight, fragrance free, and absorbs quickly without any sticky residue, which I appreciate! One thing I really love about this and other Arencia products is that they are a great value, with incredible quality ingredients that deliver great results without a hefty price tag. I highly recommend!

avis.titre: Unscented and does not cause eye irritation
avis.texte: This review is for Arencia Vitamin C Booster Serum with Glutathione, which is made in Korea. This is a yellow, opaque serum that is a mix of a cream and a gel. avis.texte: Arencia Vitamin C Booster Shot Serum with Glutathione, Niacinamide and Vitamin E for Dark Spot Care, Fine Lines & Wrinkles is advertised as a potent serum to advance your skincare routine. The product comes in a small plastic tube of 10 ml (~9 cm length). These boosters are designed for targeted application on specific areas (dark spots), not the entire face, so I expect this product should last at least two months with daily use for me. The serum has a gel-like texture, light orange-yellow color. I like that it fragrance-free. I use only a pea sized amount to dot my problem spots with uneven pigmentation. It goes on easy and glides on the skin. It absorbs well without leaving any residue or stickiness. I can use it under my SPF and makeup, it layers great without pilling. The major question is the product performance on targeting dark spots and even wrinkles. I would suggest to low all expectations from the beginning, as it is not a product capable to deliver magic results overnight or quick fix anything about the skin color. Actually, there are only several research-proven prescription products with potent skin-lightening agent that deliver more or less noticeable results targeting hyperpigmentation. From products like this Arencia Vitamin C Booster, we can expect only gradual improvement by using it (or other vit C serum) consistently over long time (months).
